line: Crazy, Keon died with his hoop dreams Used to look up to him, now I gotta look up to him
vault_lines: Used to look up to him, now I gotta look up to him
meaning:
Keon Lawrence was a Newark Native who was one of the best scorers New Jersey has ever saw. His basketball talents landed him a scholarship at Missouri University. After two seasons he returned home to play for Seton Hall. He played overseas up until he passed away in November 2019.

He died with his basketball dreams in tact wanting to give back to the younger generations in the community and also as his pro career was coming to an end he passed away around the same time.

The following line is something very relatable. Surf looked up to him growing up in the hood as someone who used his talents to make it out, music and hoops one in the same. But now surf has to look up to him on the other side. Looking up to the “heavens”

Rest In Peace Keon Lawrence 🙏🏽🙏🏽
